title: Application Entry Points
summary: This module defines the primary entry points for the application, including the desktop GUI, command-line interface, and specialized tools for image generation and MLX code generation. It orchestrates initial setup, server startup, and command execution.

nodes.label: Initialize Desktop Application
nodes.title: Desktop App Startup
nodes.description: Main entry point for the desktop application, handling UI, server, updates, and system interactions like URL scheme requests and OS signals.

nodes.label: Execute Model Runner Command
nodes.title: Model Runner Execution
nodes.description: Entry point for executing specific model runner commands, typically for inference or other model-related tasks via the command line.

nodes.label: Process CLI Commands
nodes.title: CLI Command Processor
nodes.description: Generic command-line interface entry point, responsible for parsing and executing various CLI commands using the Cobra framework.

nodes.label: Generate Images from Prompts
nodes.title: Image Generation Engine
nodes.description: Entry point for the image generation engine, supporting various models and parameters for creating images, including Z-Image and FLUX.2.

nodes.label: Generate MLX-related Code
nodes.title: MLX Code Generator
nodes.description: Entry point for a tool that parses C++ code using tree-sitter and generates MLX-related code artifacts based on templates.

nodes.label: OS Signals & Events
nodes.title: Operating System Events
nodes.description: External operating system signals (e.g., shutdown, URL scheme requests) that trigger application behavior.

nodes.label: File System I/O
nodes.title: File System Operations
nodes.description: Reading and writing files on the local file system, including models, images, and generated code.

nodes.label: Ollama API Server
nodes.title: Ollama Backend Server
nodes.description: The core Ollama API server that handles model serving, requests, and other backend logic.

nodes.label: UI Frontend Server
nodes.title: User Interface Server
nodes.description: The server responsible for serving the user interface and handling UI-specific interactions for the desktop application.

nodes.label: Application Configuration & Updates
nodes.title: Config & Update Management
nodes.description: Modules handling application configuration, logging, and software update processes.

nodes.label: Model Execution Logic
nodes.title: Model Runner Logic
nodes.description: Components responsible for executing various model types and managing their lifecycle.

nodes.label: CLI Command Framework
nodes.title: CLI Framework
nodes.description: The underlying framework (Cobra) for defining and executing command-line interface commands.

nodes.label: Model Data Access
nodes.title: Model Data Storage
nodes.description: Access and management of model files and related data from storage.

nodes.label: MLX Backend Operations
nodes.title: MLX Runtime
nodes.description: Low-level MLX operations and runtime components for accelerated computation, used by image generation.

nodes.label: Code Parsing Library
nodes.title: Tree-sitter Library
nodes.description: An external library (tree-sitter) used for parsing source code into abstract syntax trees for code generation.

groups.label: User-Facing Entry Points
groups.title: User Interaction Points
groups.description: Entry points directly interacting with users or system-level events to launch the application or process commands.

groups.label: Content Generation Entry Points
groups.title: Content Generation Tools
groups.description: Entry points for specialized tools focused on generating new content, such as images or code.

groups.label: Model Runner Entry Points
groups.title: Model Execution Interface
groups.description: Entry points specifically designed to invoke and manage the execution of various AI models.
